title: Juicy Savory Peruvian Beef Lomo Saltado
description: A flexitarian friendly Peruvian dish featuring beef strips, vegetables, and a flavorful sauce, served with rice and French fries, this recipe is a twist on the classic lomo saltado with a floral and cheese pull touch
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium high heat
Add the beef strips and cook until browned, about 3 minutes
Remove the beef from the skillet and set aside
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the skillet
Add the sliced onions and cook until they are translucent, about 3 minutes
Add the diced tomatoes and cook for an additional 2 minutes
In a small bowl, whisk together the white vinegar, soy sauce, and shio cure
Pour the sauce over the onions and tomatoes and stir to combine
Return the beef to the skillet and stir to coat with the sauce
Add the cooked French fries and stir to combine
Serve the beef and vegetable mixture over cooked rice and top with shredded cheese and chopped cilantro
